title: CCP: channel-plan registry/version + unknown-plan CH0 fallback gaps
description: DIVERGENT. Req 2a.7: plans contain 'plan identifier and version'; 'Unknown plan identifiers or versions MUST cause CH0 fallback'; plan MUST be provisioned locally (OTA cannot expand plan/power/limits). Evidence: Python conformant (python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py:256-261 ch0_fallback_required true for unknown id OR version mismatch; tests/test_ccp4_regional_channel_plans.py). C: lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/include/lichen/op_class.h compile-time table has NO version field and NO regulatory-accounting-group per channel; unknown class_id -> NULL -> lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c:578-583 falls back to duty region 0 (EU-conservative), NOT CH0 channel fallback. RUST: no plan registry at all (only OperatingClassParams in rust/lichen-hal/src/lib.rs:174-283); test/vectors/ccp4_regional_channel_plans.json has no Rust consumer. Suggested placement: C: add version field to op_class.h entries + CH0 fallback in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/link_ctx.c channel select; Rust: port channel-plan registry into lichen-core and consume ccp4_regional_channel_plans.json.
